Airport Security Sucks!

Run airport security. Find the contraband. Try not to level the terminal.

View on SteamSee the game
01 / The game

Built around a mechanic you can explain in one sentence.

Airport Security Sucks! turns the checkpoint into a loud multiplayer sandbox. Security officers inspect, interrogate, and control a crowd of suspicious travelers while smugglers improvise increasingly ridiculous ways through the line.

03 / Design

The systems behind the premise.

Developer credit — Metater · Multiplayer systems · Voice-driven gameplay

01

Asymmetric multiplayer

Security officers control the checkpoint while smugglers hide contraband, bluff, and exploit the chaos.

02

Voice-driven control

Spoken interactions and proximity voice make every inspection feel immediate, social, and unpredictable.

03

Systemic comedy

Crowds, gadgets, physics, weapons, and player decisions combine into stories the game never had to script.

04

Built to scale

The shipped game connects multiplayer infrastructure with a heavily simulated terminal full of moving parts.
